title: VetClear: CMA price-list, estimate and prescription compliance for independent vets
summary: After its market investigation, the UK competition authority (CMA) requires vet practices to publish price lists, give written estimates for bigger treatments and tell owners they can get a written prescription. Independent practices have no compliance team. VetClear builds the price page, estimate templates and client notices, and checks that the practice stays compliant.
hook: "The corporate groups have whole teams on the CMA rules. It's me and my practice manager, after evening surgery."
story:
**Priya owns an independent small-animal practice with 3 vets and 6 nurses.** The CMA's final report means she must publish a **standard price list** on her website, give a **written estimate for treatment of £500 or more** and update the client in writing if the cost will go over by more than 20%. Her team must also tell clients they can get a **written prescription** and buy medicines elsewhere.

Her practice software can print an invoice, but not a CMA-style price list or an estimate that tracks the 20% rule. She downloads guidance, makes a Word template and hopes the nurses use it. She would pay a monthly fee for one place that keeps her published prices, estimates and notices right, and shows her what is missing before a complaint does.
whyNow: The CMA published its final report on 24 March 2026, with remedies phased in through an Order and an RCVS undertaking; final orders and guidance were due in autumn 2026, with smaller businesses given extra time. Independents must be ready in 2026–2027 without a compliance team.
evidence: CMA final report on vet services for household pets published in March 2026; remedies implemented through an Order on vet businesses and an RCVS undertaking [GOV.UK]
Practices must publish a price list covering consultations, vaccinations, written prescription fees and common procedures [Whito / Pharmacy2U]

Written estimate and itemised bill for treatment expected to cost £500 or more incl. VAT; written update if likely to exceed the estimate by more than 20% [CMA remedies coverage: Improve International / Price Bailey]
Prescription fee cap: the provisional decision proposed £16; later coverage cites £21 for the first item; check the final Order [Bird & Bird / Money to the Masses]
Over 60% of practices are owned by six large groups, so independents compete with companies that have compliance teams (industry commentary) [Agilio]
Smaller businesses get longer to comply than large groups [BVA]

whyReal.title: A legal order with a date
whyReal.text: The remedies are not best practice; they are an Order from the competition authority plus RCVS professional rules. Every practice is in scope.

whyReal.title: Independents are under-resourced
whyReal.text: Six large groups own most practices and have legal and compliance teams. Independents have an owner and a practice manager.

whyReal.title: Practice software lags
whyReal.text: Practice management systems will add features over time, but price pages, estimate thresholds and client notices are needed now.

whyReal.title: Simple to build
whyReal.text: Price list builder, estimate templates with a 20% tracker, notices and a checklist: forms and documents, not deep integrations.

whoPays.label: Customer
whoPays.text: independent vet practices in the UK (1–5 sites), small-animal and mixed.

whoPays.label: Start market
whoPays.text: UK only (the rules are UK-specific); later, pricing transparency tools for vets in other countries if regulators follow.

solution.title: Price list builder
solution.text: the practice enters or imports prices; VetClear produces a public price page in the required categories and a version for the RCVS comparison listing.

solution.title: Estimate templates
solution.text: itemised written estimates for treatments of £500+, with aftercare lines and a 20% overrun alert that prompts a written update.

solution.title: Client notices
solution.text: ready text for prescription rights, ownership disclosure and fees, for the website, reception and emails.

solution.title: Compliance checklist
solution.text: a live checklist of each CMA duty with deadlines for small businesses, and a monthly reminder to review prices.

solution.title: Evidence pack
solution.text: a dated history of published prices and estimates, ready if a client complains.

must: Written estimate builder with 20% overrun alert
later: Integration with common practice management systems
AI price-list import from old PDFs

techStack: LLM for importing old price lists
